title: Accounts are switched on
thisBuild: The app now talks to the Mess Machine server, so the sign-in and online parts of Settings are live for the first time.
The web version gets the same server on its next build, so a phone and a computer can open the same mess together.
Still new: Re-pitch on the Sample sheet's Play tab, and Auto-pitch new sounds in Settings, Playing.
watch: Try signing in with your email. If no code arrives, that is the mail setup, not you.
Once signed in, save a mess online and open it on the computer.
limits: Sign-in codes need the mail service hooked up on the server. Until then the email may hold a link the app cannot use.
Only your own email can get codes for now. A second tester has to be added to the server's team first.
